Explore the Top Market Report, now Top Export Market Rankings for environmental technologies. This index considers individual regulatory, economic, and market conditions to rank where U.S. environmental tech firms will find competitive advantage. # Top Export Market Rankings - Environmental Technologies Report Index. ITA defines environmental technologies goods and services as those that prevent or mitigate pollution, generate compliance with environmental regulations, manage or reduce waste streams, remediate contaminated sites, develop and operate environmental infrastructure, allow the provision of environmental resources, and/or foster environmental protection and resource efficiency. ITA categorizes environmental technologies into three sectors: air pollution monitoring and control, waste management and recycling, and water and wastewater treatment. This tool uses 108 HS codes as a proxy to represent the environmental technologies sector, including air pollution monitoring and control, water and wastewater treatment, waste management and recycling, and monitoring and instrumentation technologies and equipment.
